title: Notification
description: Notification object. Content available in "object" is dependent on the notification type.

id.description: Eliq internal ID of the notification

read.description: Could be used to indicate it the notification is read or not. Needs to be used together with PATCH notifications.

created_date.description: The date when the notification was created. The date is in UTC (Z flag is missing due to design mistake :))

header.description: Header of notification. In language code set for the user

content.description: Content of notification in language code set for the user. May contain new line marker '\n'

object.description: Object containing detailed information from the source of the notification. E.g. a monthly insights object.
